{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the handle of a weapon|[[Varner Hilts]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]|linebreak=1}}
The '''hilt''', sometimes called a '''grip''', was the handle by which an individual would grasp a bladed weapon. Certain types of [[Sword/Legends|swords]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] could be fitted with a modified hilt in order to give the wielder of the weapon a better hold, increase the damage potential, or to protect the hand.

The modification of a hilt could have involved an alteration in the physical shape, the final weight, or the material from which the hilt was produced, among other factors. In addition, certain species such as the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] or [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] modified hilts to suit their particular needs or fighting styles. These augmented hilts were often found in a range of caliber from basic to superior.
